title: Pre-failure offline memory repair (MemDream)
discovery: Offline Dreamer/Analyst/Consolidator agents probe and repair a memory graph before retrieval fails; reversible soft decay.
relevance: Template for a World0 Dream Mechanism operating on concepts and relations rather than facts.

title: Ontology as a dynamically refined agent kernel (OaK)
discovery: Task-oriented ontologies/KGs are built and refined from judge feedback.
relevance: Validates feedback-driven ontology evolution; contrast with World0's single structure plus context projection.
action: Full-text read; extract judge-feedback loop design.

title: Consolidation needs write governance (SSGM)
discovery: Evolving memory risks logical drift; validation at consolidation is proposed as a guard.
relevance: Supports concept-integrity-first priority for LLM-written cards/relations.
